# Complete migration qualification

These are genuine Actual26.10.0 exports, authored through its public API and
engine commands. No source database was edited. The pinned source commit is
`2bebdbaae0b701120a8cad9d56aafd64fa04c577`.

`complete.zip` extends the independently generated Monte Carlo strategy archive
(itself extending crossover, budget analysis and historical reports). It adds
account grouping, a merged payee, payee location, tag, category notes, allocation
automations, a named cleanup pool, a rule, a manual schedule and a saved filter.
It retains transfers, splits, hidden/closed/off-budget references, allocation
history and saved reporting metadata. No schedule automatically posts.

`large.zip` adds 10,000 genuine purchases. `deleted-history.zip` deletes those
purchases through the source transaction command; all 10,000 tombstones remain
in the export. `empty.zip` has no transactions. Each budget is reloaded before
recording the source AQL ledger digest and account balances. The manifest records
every source table count and archive digest. Generated archives are immutable;
`--check` reloads them and verifies independent source observations.

Run from the repository root:

```sh
node actualBudget/tools/generate-complete-migration-source.mjs --check
node actualBudget/tools/check-complete-migration-http.mjs
```

The HTTP checker owns one disposable server installation, imports all four
budgets, restarts between staging and activation, replays activation receipts
after another restart, reconciles financial/domain records through portable
backups, restores each backup and verifies original archives/audits remain exact.
It never inspects the running server's database. Archive SQLite reads only
inspect the exported source format. The manifest is an observation of the
source engine, not output generated by the replacement converter.

Additional migration dimensions use their established independent witnesses:
`bank-linked-source-26.10.json` for linked-to-manual retirement, `android-upgrade/`
for original pending operations, and schema17 fixtures for existing native state.
See `docs/complete-migration-validation.md` for the combined acceptance record.
